stories.title: Want to win a free copy of GTA VI? You'll have to travel to Fort Wayne and attend a Komets game first
stories.summary: Hoosiers can get their hands on a copy of GTA VI for free, but they'll first have to travel to Fort Wayne and buy tickets to Sunday's Komets hockey game.

stories.title: 'We need to close that gap' | Housing report shows Hoosier renters turn to hotels as last resort
stories.summary: The Fair Housing Center of Central Indiana finds families who cannot find affordable and accessible housing often turn to hotels.

stories.title: Motorcyclist killed in 2-vehicle crash on Indy's north side
stories.summary: Police said the crash happened around 5 p.m. Nov. 20 at the intersection of North College Avenue at East 82nd Street on the north side of Indianapolis.

stories.title: Indiana Diaper Bank, Eskenazi mark 1 million diapers donated through partnership | Inspiring Indiana
stories.summary: The program addresses diaper insecurity by identifying patients in need and connecting them with the right resources.

stories.title: Indiana gas prices fall ahead of Thanksgiving travel as refinery issues ease | What's the Deal?
stories.summary: GasBuddy says multiple factors are behind a recent decline in the price of motor fuels.

stories.title: 'This is what teamwork looks like' | Evansville first responders honored for life saving efforts following serious crash
stories.summary: The Evansville Fire Department held a ceremony to recognize those who responded to an August multi-vehicle crash involving a charter bus on the Lloyd Expressway.

stories.title: Eskenazi reports data breach involving patient electronic health information
stories.summary: An Eskenazi Health spokesperson said they are investigating the incidents they say occurred on July 28, Aug. 31 and Sept. 21, 2026.

stories.title: Suspect killed in Lawrence police shooting; No officers injured
stories.summary: The incident was reported around 3 p.m. Nov. 20 on Wellington Avenue, near East 46th Street and North Franklin Road.

stories.title: Indianapolis husband, wife sentenced following conviction in deadly 2023 crash
stories.summary: Bradley Woods was driving a pickup truck that struck a car driven by 20-year-old Avery May, who was killed. His wife drove him away from the scene.

stories.title: Fishers set to host inaugural Big Ten women’s volleyball tournament
stories.summary: There are 15 teams from the conference playing in a five-round, five-day tournament this weekend at the Fishers Event Center.

stories.title: ISP: Ohio teen clocked going 130 mph on northern Indiana highway arrested for reckless driving
stories.summary: Police said an Ohio teen was arrested Friday after an officer clocked his 2006 Honda at well over 100 mph on U.S. 31 in northern Indiana.

stories.title: Connersville man sentenced after pleading guilty but mentally ill in 2022 cemetery killings
stories.summary: Joshua Lee Farmer agreed to plead guilty but mentally ill to the murders of Thomas Combs and Joshua Durham.
